title: REQ-20261109-OPS003 — Caldova Pension application: $1,250,000 account-based pension, $78,000 p.a. monthly, Helen as reversionary (George Papadopoulos, CS-1077881 → CP-3077881)
content:
Pension application received on 9 Nov 2026 from adviser Marcus Tan (adviser code ADV-20871, Bayside Financial Partners, Brighton) for George Papadopoulos (DOB 03/04/1960, age 66; Oakleigh VIC 3166; georgep@example.com; 0491 570 159). George is a retired electrical contractor — forty years on the tools — who wants a steady income and to stop worrying about running out. His wife Helen Papadopoulos is 63.

Source account: Caldova Super (Select) CS-1077881, balance $1,284,600 at 9 Nov 2026.

Request: start a Caldova Pension (account-based) with $1,250,000 in a new pension account, CP-3077881, leaving $34,600 in the accumulation account CS-1077881. Requested start date: 16 Nov 2026. Income: $78,000 a year paid monthly — $6,500 on the 15th of each month, first payment 15 Dec 2026 — to George's nominated bank account (account name matches the member ✅). Reversionary beneficiary: Helen Papadopoulos (spouse) — the pension continues to Helen if George dies first. Investment instruction (Statement of Advice dated 4 Nov 2026): Caldova Managed Portfolio — Balanced, with a cash reserve to fund pension payments, to be set by Caldova Investment Solutions.

Documents: Caldova Pension application signed and dated by George on 6 Nov 2026; reversionary nomination with Helen's details and confirmation that they are married; identity verified at onboarding (proof of age); TFN held (*** *** 507); adviser declaration that George has never had a retirement-phase income stream. Tax components of CS-1077881 before commencement: 9% tax-free, 91% taxable — so the pension's components are fixed at commencement as tax-free $112,500 and taxable $1,137,500.

NIGO checklist: all items in good order ✅.

Checks required (Benefits & Eligibility): condition of release — age 65+ (no retirement declaration needed); transfer balance cap — general cap $2.1 million for 2026-27; minimum annual payment — 5% at age 66, pro-rated for the first year; reversionary nominee eligible (spouse).

Routing and approvals: Benefits & Eligibility → Investment Solutions (income strategy: two-year cash reserve; compare strategies) → Transfers & Rollovers (internal transfer CS-1077881 → CP-3077881; transfer balance credit reported to the ATO) → Payments (commence the pension; Team Leader approval in Microsoft Teams is required because the commencement amount is $1,000,000 or more) → Client Communications ('welcome to retirement' letter to George; confirmation to Marcus).
